methodology.host: official Config, ToolRegistry and read_file/replace/write_file; build, policy/confirmation and execute on each call
methodology.scope: Gemini SDK 0.27.2 local filesystem configuration; OS sandbox, CLI profiles, model turns and billing have separate boundaries
methodology.matching: official matching, occurrence validation, rendering and newline rules; Config disableLLMCorrection=true in both lanes
methodology.confirmation: official policy bus; ask_user invokes generated confirmation and ProceedOnce callback; human interaction delay is outside timing
methodology.known_inputs: fixtures supply literal replacements; global replacement specifies the exact expected_replacements count
methodology.timing: sum of performance.now tool durations; fixture creation, serialization counts and independent byte oracle are outside
methodology.setup: SDK verification/import bootstrap once; Config/auth fixture/registry/native handshake timed per provider and policy; persistent fixture warmed per scenario
methodology.tool_bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify tool arguments and actual ToolResult; thrown exception message bytes are a separate field and join the local boundary total
methodology.bridge_bytes: actual native child stdin/stdout; capability handshake recorded under setup and excluded from warm samples
methodology.correctness: complete expected file set and independent expected bytes; provider equivalence additionally checks actual result hashes and storage hashes
methodology.p95: nearest rank; three samples give the maximum
methodology.ordering: policy group; original then native; fixture order; per-fixture warm-up
